label: G01_HOSTED_METADATA
access: read-only SELECT on pg_catalog of hosted Enteng; no business rows, no mutation
owner_decision: G-01 option 1 (23 Sep 2026): copy only the differing definitions from Enteng read-only; cover the two extra *_seq1 sequences; T3 stays HOLD until every difference is explained and the AO-AV install passes

constraints.def: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'ACTIVE'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'VOIDED'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'POSTED'::character varying, 'CORRECTED'::character varying, 'REVERSED'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((record_lifecycle IS NULL) OR ((record_lifecycle)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'POSTED'::character varying, 'CORRECTED'::character varying, 'REVERSED'::character varying])::text[]))))

CHECK (((movement_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPENING'::character varying, 'QC_GOOD'::character varying, 'SALE_RESERVE'::character varying, 'SALE'::character varying, 'SALE_RETURN'::character varying, 'REBRAND_OUT'::character varying, 'REBRAND_IN'::character varying, 'BS_OUT'::character varying, 'REWORK_IN'::character varying, 'ADJUSTMENT'::character varying, 'REVERSAL'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((((status)::text = 'DRAFT'::text) AND (post_seq IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['POSTED'::character varying, 'REVERSED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (post_seq IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((invoice_match_state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['UNMATCHED'::character varying, 'PARTIAL'::character varying, 'MATCHED'::character varying, 'DIRECT_FINAL'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((price_source)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['BENCHMARK'::character varying, 'SUPPLIER_QUOTE'::character varying, 'SUPPLIER_INVOICE'::character varying, 'MANUAL_ESTIMATE'::character varying, 'MIGRATION'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((movement_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPENING'::character varying, 'PURCHASE'::character varying, 'CUTTING_ISSUE'::character varying, 'CUTTING_RETURN'::character varying, 'CONTRACTOR_ISSUE'::character varying, 'PERSONAL_USE'::character varying, 'INTERNAL_USE'::character varying, 'SAMPLE'::character varying, 'DAMAGE'::character varying, 'LOSS'::character varying, 'SUPPLIER_RETURN'::character varying, 'ADJUSTMENT'::character varying, 'TRANSFER_OUT'::character varying, 'TRANSFER_IN'::character varying, 'REVERSAL'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((completion_mode IS NULL) OR ((completion_mode)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ALL_READY'::character varying, 'PARTIAL_SELECTION'::character varying])::text[]))))
CHECK (((rate_basis)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CONTRACTOR_RATE'::character varying, 'PO_SNAPSHOT'::character varying, 'LAUNDRY_ZERO'::character varying, 'LEGACY_CLIENT'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((health_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['BELUM_CUKUP_DATA'::character varying, 'AMAN'::character varying, 'RENDAH'::character varying, 'PERLU_PESAN'::character varying, 'PERLU_PRODUKSI'::character varying, 'KRITIS'::character varying])::text[])))

views.def:
SELECT ('BS:'::text || (b.id)::text) AS case_key,
    'BS'::text AS case_type,
    'bs_cases'::text AS source_table,
    b.id AS source_id,
    b.bs_number AS case_number,
    b.physical_at AS opened_at,
    (b.status)::text AS status,
    b.row_version,
    b.qty_pcs,
    b.po_id,
    po.po_number,
    po.model_id,
    pm.model_name,
    b.cutting_group_id,
    cg.group_number,
    b.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    b.responsible_contractor_id,
    ct.contractor_name,
    b.responsible_vendor_id,
    lv.vendor_name,
    (b.detected_at_stage)::text AS detected_stage,
    (b.cause_source)::text AS cause_source,
    (b.untracked_type)::text AS untracked_type,
    b.source_laundry_receipt_line_id,
    b.qc_item_id,
    NULL::uuid AS laundry_delivery_id,
    0 AS held_payroll_qty,
    COALESCE(( SELECT (sum(e.remaining_qty))::integer AS sum
           FROM ((erp.v_payroll_eligible_work_lines e
             JOIN erp.rework_component_lines rcl ON (((e.source_type = 'REWORK'::text) AND (rcl.id = e.source_id))))
             JOIN erp.bs_case_components bcc ON ((bcc.id = rcl.bs_case_component_id)))
          WHERE (bcc.bs_case_id = b.id)), 0) AS nota_eligible_rework_qty,
    COALESCE(( SELECT (sum(r.qty_pcs))::integer AS sum
           FROM erp.bs_resolutions r
          WHERE (r.bs_case_id = b.id)), 0) AS resolved_qty,
    ((b.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RESOLVED'::character varying, 'SCRAPPED'::character varying, 'WRITTEN_OFF'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])) AS is_closed,
        CASE
            WHEN ((b.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPEN'::character varying, 'PARTIAL'::character varying])::text[])) THEN 'START_REWORK_OR_DISPOSITION'::text
            WHEN ((b.status)::text = 'IN_REWORK'::text) THEN 'COMPLETE_REWORK'::text
            ELSE 'VIEW_OR_REVERSE'::text
        END AS next_action,
    concat_ws(' '::text, b.bs_number, po.po_number, pm.model_name, cg.group_number, p.sku, p.product_name, ct.contractor_name, lv.vendor_name, b.status, b.cause_source, b.untracked_type, b.legacy_reference, b.notes) AS search_text,
    b.notes
   FROM ((((((erp.bs_cases b
     LEFT JOIN erp.production_orders po ON ((po.id = b.po_id)))
     LEFT JOIN erp.product_models pm ON ((pm.id = po.model_id)))
     LEFT JOIN erp.cutting_groups cg ON ((cg.id = b.cutting_group_id)))
     LEFT JOIN erp.products p ON ((p.id = b.product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN erp.contractors ct ON ((ct.id = b.responsible_contractor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN erp.laundry_vendors lv ON ((lv.id = b.responsible_vendor_id)))
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('LAUNDRY:'::text || (c.id)::text) AS case_key,
    (c.claim_type)::text AS case_type,
    'laundry_claims'::text AS source_table,
    c.id AS source_id,
    c.claim_number AS case_number,
    c.opened_at,
    (c.status)::text AS status,
    c.row_version,
    c.qty_claimed AS qty_pcs,
    ld.po_id,
    po.po_number,
    po.model_id,
    pm.model_name,
    NULL::uuid AS cutting_group_id,
    NULL::character varying AS group_number,
    NULL::uuid AS product_id,
    NULL::character varying AS sku,
    NULL::character varying AS product_name,
    NULL::uuid AS responsible_contractor_id,
    NULL::character varying AS contractor_name,
    c.vendor_id AS responsible_vendor_id,
    lv.vendor_name,
    'LAUNDRY'::text AS detected_stage,
    'LAUNDRY'::text AS cause_source,
    NULL::text AS untracked_type,
    c.receipt_line_id AS source_laundry_receipt_line_id,
    NULL::uuid AS qc_item_id,
    c.delivery_id AS laundry_delivery_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (((c.claim_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['STUCK'::character varying, 'MISSING'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((c.status)::text <> 'REJECTED'::text)) THEN c.qty_claimed
            ELSE 0
        END AS held_payroll_qty,
    0 AS nota_eligible_rework_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN ((c.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SETTLED'::character varying, 'WRITTEN_OFF'::character varying])::text[])) THEN c.qty_claimed
            ELSE 0
        END AS resolved_qty,
    ((c.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SETTLED'::character varying, 'WRITTEN_OFF'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying])::text[])) AS is_closed,
        CASE
            WHEN ((c.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPEN'::character varying, 'ACCEPTED'::character varying])::text[])) THEN 'RESOLVE_CLAIM'::text
            ELSE 'VIEW_OR_REVERSE'::text
        END AS next_action,
    concat_ws(' '::text, c.claim_number, c.claim_type, c.status, ld.delivery_number, po.po_number, pm.model_name, lv.vendor_name, c.qty_claimed, c.compensation_amount, c.notes) AS search_text,
    c.notes
   FROM ((((erp.laundry_claims c
     JOIN erp.laundry_deliveries ld ON ((ld.id = c.delivery_id)))
     JOIN erp.production_orders po ON ((po.id = ld.po_id)))
     LEFT JOIN erp.product_models pm ON ((pm.id = po.model_id)))
     JOIN erp.laundry_vendors lv ON ((lv.id = c.vendor_id)));

WITH invoice AS (
         SELECT sh_1.id AS sale_id,
            (COALESCE(sum(si.line_total), (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS gross_amount
           FROM (erp.sales_headers sh_1
             JOIN erp.sales_items si ON ((si.sale_id = sh_1.id)))
          GROUP BY sh_1.id
        ), payment AS (
         SELECT sp.sale_id,
            (COALESCE(sum(sp.amount), (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS paid_amount
           FROM erp.sales_payments sp
          WHERE ((sp.status)::text = 'POSTED'::text)
          GROUP BY sp.sale_id
        ), returned AS (
         SELECT sr.sale_id,
            (COALESCE(sum(sri.refund_amount), (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS return_amount
           FROM (erp.sales_returns sr
             JOIN erp.sales_return_items sri ON ((sri.return_id = sr.id)))
          WHERE ((sr.status)::text = 'POSTED'::text)
          GROUP BY sr.sale_id
        )
 SELECT sh.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    sh.id AS sale_id,
    sh.sale_number,
    sh.sale_date,
    sh.due_date,
    i.gross_amount AS invoice_amount,
    (COALESCE(p.paid_amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS paid_amount,
    (GREATEST(((i.gross_amount - COALESCE(r.return_amount, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(p.paid_amount, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS outstanding_amount,
    (COALESCE(r.return_amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS posted_return_amount,
    (GREATEST((i.gross_amount - COALESCE(r.return_amount, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS net_invoice_amount,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(p.paid_amount, (0)::numeric) - (i.gross_amount - COALESCE(r.return_amount, (0)::numeric))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS credit_amount
   FROM ((((erp.sales_headers sh
     JOIN erp.customers c ON ((c.id = sh.customer_id)))
     JOIN invoice i ON ((i.sale_id = sh.id)))
     LEFT JOIN payment p ON ((p.sale_id = sh.id)))
     LEFT JOIN returned r ON ((r.sale_id = sh.id)))
  WHERE ((sh.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['POSTED'::character varying, 'PARTIAL_PAID'::character varying, 'PAID'::character varying])::text[]));

WITH sent AS (
         SELECT d.po_id,
            sum(l.qty_sent_pcs) AS sent_qty_pcs
           FROM (erp.laundry_deliveries d
             JOIN erp.laundry_delivery_lines l ON ((l.delivery_id = d.id)))
          WHERE ((d.status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'REVERSED'::character varying])::text[]))
          GROUP BY d.po_id
        ), returned AS (
         SELECT d.po_id,
            sum(rl.qty_good_received) AS good_returned_qty_pcs,
            sum(rl.qty_bs_laundry) AS bs_returned_qty_pcs,
            sum((rl.qty_good_received + rl.qty_bs_laundry)) AS returned_qty_pcs
           FROM ((erp.laundry_deliveries d
             JOIN erp.laundry_receipts r_1 ON (((r_1.delivery_id = d.id) AND ((r_1.status)::text = 'POSTED'::text))))
             JOIN erp.laundry_receipt_lines rl ON ((rl.receipt_id = r_1.id)))
          WHERE ((d.status)::text <> 'REVERSED'::text)
          GROUP BY d.po_id
        ), resolved AS (
         SELECT d.po_id,
            sum(c.qty_claimed) AS resolved_claim_qty_pcs
           FROM (erp.laundry_claims c
             JOIN erp.laundry_deliveries d ON ((d.id = c.delivery_id)))
          WHERE (((c.claim_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['MISSING'::character varying, 'STUCK'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((c.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SETTLED'::character varying, 'WRITTEN_OFF'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((d.status)::text <> 'REVERSED'::text))
          GROUP BY d.po_id
        )
 SELECT po.id AS po_id,
    po.po_number,
    po.status AS po_status,
    COALESCE(s.sent_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint) AS sent_qty_pcs,
    COALESCE(r.good_returned_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint) AS good_returned_qty_pcs,
    COALESCE(r.bs_returned_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint) AS bs_returned_qty_pcs,
    COALESCE(r.returned_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint) AS returned_qty_pcs,
    COALESCE(x.resolved_claim_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint) AS resolved_claim_qty_pcs,
    GREATEST(((COALESCE(s.sent_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint) - COALESCE(r.returned_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint)) - COALESCE(x.resolved_claim_qty_pcs, (0)::bigint)), (0)::bigint) AS laundry_outstanding_qty_pcs
   FROM (((erp.production_orders po
     JOIN sent s ON ((s.po_id = po.id)))
     LEFT JOIN returned r ON ((r.po_id = po.id)))
     LEFT JOIN resolved x ON ((x.po_id = po.id)));

SELECT n.id AS payroll_id,
    n.payroll_number,
    n.contractor_id,
    c.contractor_code,
    c.contractor_name,
    n.period_start,
    n.period_end,
    n.status,
    n.row_version,
    n.payment_date,
    n.settled_at,
    n.labor_total,
    n.attendance_total,
    n.reimburse_total,
    n.deduction_total,
    n.manual_adjustment,
    n.net_payable,
    COALESCE(x.work_line_count, (0)::bigint) AS work_line_count,
    COALESCE(x.work_qty, (0)::bigint) AS work_qty,
    COALESCE(e.eligible_line_count, (0)::bigint) AS eligible_line_count,
    COALESCE(e.eligible_qty, (0)::bigint) AS eligible_qty,
    (COALESCE(e.eligible_amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(24,2) AS eligible_amount,
    ((n.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'CALCULATED'::character varying, 'REVIEW'::character varying])::text[])) AS can_merge,
    ((n.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['APPROVED'::character varying, 'PAID'::character varying, 'REVERSED'::character varying])::text[])) AS is_locked,
    n.notes,
    n.created_at,
    n.updated_at
   FROM (((erp.payroll_settlements n
     JOIN erp.contractors c ON ((c.id = n.contractor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS work_line_count,
            COALESCE(sum(w.qty_payable), (0)::bigint) AS work_qty
           FROM erp.payroll_work_items w
          WHERE (w.payroll_id = n.id)) x ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS eligible_line_count,
            COALESCE(sum(q.remaining_qty), (0)::bigint) AS eligible_qty,
            COALESCE(sum(((q.remaining_qty)::numeric * q.rate_snapshot)), (0)::numeric) AS eligible_amount
           FROM erp.v_payroll_eligible_work_lines q
          WHERE ((q.contractor_id = n.contractor_id) AND ((q.eligible_at)::date <= n.period_end))) e ON (true));

WITH laundry_sent AS (
         SELECT ldl.cutting_group_id,
            sum(ldl.qty_sent_pcs) AS sent_qty
           FROM (erp.laundry_delivery_lines ldl
             JOIN erp.laundry_deliveries ld ON ((ld.id = ldl.delivery_id)))
          WHERE ((ld.status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'REVERSED'::character varying])::text[]))
          GROUP BY ldl.cutting_group_id
        ), laundry_returned AS (
         SELECT ldl.cutting_group_id,
            sum((lrl.qty_good_received + lrl.qty_bs_laundry)) AS physically_returned_qty
           FROM ((erp.laundry_receipt_lines lrl
             JOIN erp.laundry_receipts lr ON (((lr.id = lrl.receipt_id) AND ((lr.status)::text = 'POSTED'::text))))
             JOIN erp.laundry_delivery_lines ldl ON ((ldl.id = lrl.delivery_line_id)))
          GROUP BY ldl.cutting_group_id
        ), base AS (
         SELECT wcl.id AS source_id,
            wce.id AS completion_id,
            wce.po_id,
            wce.contractor_id,
            wce.cutting_group_id,
            wcl.work_component_id,
            wce.physical_at,
            wcl.qty_payable,
            wcl.rate_snapshot,
            COALESCE(ls.sent_qty, (0)::bigint) AS laundry_sent_qty,
            COALESCE(lr.physically_returned_qty, (0)::bigint) AS laundry_returned_qty,
            (ls.cutting_group_id IS NOT NULL) AS laundry_required
           FROM (((erp.work_completion_lines wcl
             JOIN erp.work_completion_events wce ON (((wce.id = wcl.completion_id) AND ((wce.status)::text = 'POSTED'::text))))
             LEFT JOIN laundry_sent ls ON ((ls.cutting_group_id = wce.cutting_group_id)))
             LEFT JOIN laundry_returned lr ON ((lr.cutting_group_id = wce.cutting_group_id)))
        ), allocated AS (
         SELECT pwi.source_id,
            pwi.work_component_id,
            (sum(pwi.qty_payable))::integer AS allocated_qty
           FROM (erp.payroll_work_items pwi
             JOIN erp.payroll_settlements ps ON ((ps.id = pwi.payroll_id)))
          WHERE (((pwi.source_type)::text = 'PRODUCTION'::text) AND ((ps.status)::text <> 'REVERSED'::text))
          GROUP BY pwi.source_id, pwi.work_component_id
        )
 SELECT b.source_id,
    b.completion_id,
    b.po_id,
    b.contractor_id,
    b.cutting_group_id,
    b.work_component_id,
    b.physical_at,
    b.qty_payable AS source_qty_payable,
    b.rate_snapshot,
    b.laundry_required,
    b.laundry_sent_qty,
    b.laundry_returned_qty,
    b.qty_payable AS eligible_after_laundry_qty,
    0 AS held_for_laundry_qty,
    COALESCE(a.allocated_qty, 0) AS allocated_to_nonreversed_payroll_qty,
    GREATEST((b.qty_payable - COALESCE(a.allocated_qty, 0)), 0) AS remaining_eligible_qty,
    round(((GREATEST((b.qty_payable - COALESCE(a.allocated_qty, 0)), 0))::numeric * b.rate_snapshot), 2) AS remaining_eligible_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN (NOT b.laundry_required) THEN 'COMPONENT_PAYABLE_NO_LAUNDRY'::text
            WHEN ((b.laundry_sent_qty > 0) AND (b.laundry_returned_qty >= b.laundry_sent_qty)) THEN 'COMPONENT_PAYABLE_LAUNDRY_COMPLETE'::text
            ELSE 'COMPONENT_PAYABLE_LAUNDRY_OUTSTANDING'::text
        END AS eligibility_state
   FROM (base b
     LEFT JOIN allocated a ON (((a.source_id = b.source_id) AND (a.work_component_id = b.work_component_id))));
